raw_segments.text: While thus in talk the flying hours they pass, the sun had finished more than half his race,
and they perhaps in words and tears had spent the little time of stay which he even had
But thus the Sybil chides their long delay.
Night rushes down and headlong drives the day.
Tease here in different paths the way divides, the right to Pluto's golden palace guides,
the left to that unhappy region tens, which to the depth of Tartarus descends, the seat
of night profound and punished fiends.
Then thus day fobbus, O sacred maid, for bear to chide and be your will obeyed, low
to the secret shadows I retire to pay my penance till my years expire, proceed auspicious prince
with glory crowned and born to better fates than I have found.
He said, and while he said, his steps he turned to secret shadows and in silence mourned.
